summary.text: Tempest takes place on Rath, an artificial plane that Yawgmoth ordered built as a staging point for an invasion of Dominaria, and it follows Gerrard Capashen and the crew of the Skyship Weatherlight as they travel there.

Volrath, evincar of Rath, has Sisay abducted to lure the Weatherlight to Rath, where he ambushes it and captures Tahngarth, Karn and the Legacy artifacts, leaving Gerrard to fall into the Skyshroud Forest.

Gerrard is declared the Korvecdal, which wins the crew the help of Eladamri's elven rebels against the Stronghold, and Gerrard leads the Weatherlight back to free Sisay and retake the Legacy from Volrath.
